rows.label: tlk47100072_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh? You have a very strange story
of destiny around you.

rows.label: tlk47100072_01_msg0002
rows.name:
It's my instinct. Everyone carries
their destiny on their shoulders. And
you have the strangest one I've seen.

rows.label: tlk47100072_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Hey, hey! When that mysterious story
is over, tell me all about it!

rows.label: tlk47100072_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Phonexes love listening to
stories. Especially ones
about heroes and adventures!
